title: Naturality of the Jacobi-Zariski connecting map for a quotient

source.place: More on Algebra, Section Tag 07E4 (section-geometrically-regular, line 8678): 'The Jacobi-Zariski sequence is a canonical exact sequence H_1(L_{K/k}) -> m/m^2 -> Omega_{A/k} (x)_A K -> Omega_{K/k} -> 0 because H_1(L_{K/A}) = m/m^2'; and the commutative diagram in the proof of Proposition 07E5, equivalence of (3) and (4) (line 8752); the maps of Algebra Lemma Tag 00S2 (line 35412), whose proof says 'The precise definition of the maps is omitted'. Tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags

proof.text: Construct c by lifting the S-linear composite of KaehlerDifferential.map R R S B with the tensor map omega -> 1 tensor omega. LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul and tensor balancing prove the displayed generator formula.

Apply Mathlib Algebra.Extension.cotangentComplex_comp_h1CotangentEquivCotangent to the quotient extension P. Its Ring is B, so this proves delta composed with theta equals partial_B. Rewrite the first desired identity by this equality and associativity of linear-map composition.

For Q = Generators.self S C and Q′ = Generators.self B C, the default morphism fixes each variable, and MvPolynomial.algHom_ext identifies its toAlgHom with MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap S B). For each monomial, Generators.H1Cotangent.δAux_monomial and the generator formula for c show that the auxiliary coefficient derivative commutes with this polynomial map. MvPolynomial.induction_on′ and additivity extend this to every polynomial.

Represent any H1 class by Extension.Cotangent.mk of a kernel polynomial using Extension.Cotangent.mk_surjective. The H1 map is the restriction of the cotangent map, whose value on this representative is Extension.Cotangent.map_mk. Generators.H1Cotangent.δ_eq_δAux computes both connecting maps by the auxiliary derivative; the polynomial identity from the preceding step proves the equality. Extensionality finishes the linear-map identity.

mathlib_candidate: Not a leaf (B8). The case S = B is Algebra.Extension.cotangentComplex_comp_h1CotangentEquivCotangent (Mathlib/RingTheory/Extension/ExtendScalars.lean:129-131, read): for an extension P of S over R, P.cotangentComplex ∘ P.h1CotangentEquivCotangent = Algebra.H1Cotangent.δ R P.Ring S, i.e. δ∘θ = ∂_B with B = P.Ring, C = S; it needs the agreement of h1CotangentEquivCotangent (line 121, built from the default hom of P.extendScalars, i.e. a section) with θ of lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-surjection-h1, which is not stated. The formula (c) for Mathlib's connecting map is Algebra.Generators.H1Cotangent.δ_eq_δAux with δAux (Mathlib/RingTheory/Kaehler/JacobiZariski.lean:233-241, 396-418, read). split_report.summary: Statement changed in clause (c): lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-homology-sequence only asserts that some connecting map exists ('constructed in the proof'), so 'the connecting map' of that node is not determined by its statement and the identity could not be proved from it (C3); (c) now defines ∂_S explicitly by differentiating the coefficients of g (the value the snake-lemma construction of that node's proof gives, and Mathlib's δAux), and the statement adds that ∂_S, ∂_B, c, δ are well defined. Proof in 5 steps by direct computation (proof_origin agent; Stacks 00S2 omits the maps): models of H_1 and ι via the any-variables Kähler basis and the functoriality node; well-definedness through the derivation D on S[C]; θι(h) = Σ (s_α1_B)σ^α mod I^2 via a section σ; δ of it by the Leibniz rule, the extra terms being Σ_c γ(∂g/∂[c]) dσ(c) = 0 because h is a cycle; the case S = B by (2) of the functoriality node. No new node. Mathlib: S = B case is cotangentComplex_comp_h1CotangentEquivCotangent (ExtendScalars.lean:129) up to the identification of θ; formula is δ_eq_δAux; not a leaf. The citer lem-weil-pbc-geometrically-regular-h1-injective (steps 1, 6) uses exactness of the Jacobi-Zariski sequence for the node's ∂ together with this identity for the explicit ∂: it needs the statement of lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-homology-sequence to say that its ∂ is given by formula (c).

lean.statement: theorem jacobiZariski_connectingMap_naturality (R : Type u) (S : Type v) (B : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing B] [Algebra R S] [Algebra S B] [Algebra R B] [IsScalarTower R S B] (I : Ideal B) : let C := B ⧸ I let P := Extension.ofSurjective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R B C) (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) let ι := H1Cotangent.map S B C C let θ := P.h1CotangentEquivCotangent let partialS := H1Cotangent.δ R S C let partialB := H1Cotangent.δ R B C let δ := P.cotangentComplex ∃ c : C ⊗[S] Ω[S⁄R] →ₗ[C] C ⊗[B] Ω[B⁄R], (∀ (x : C) (s : S), c (x ⊗ₜ[S] D R S s) = x ⊗ₜ[B] D R B (algebraMap S B s)) ∧ (δ.comp (θ.toLinearMap.comp ι) = c.comp partialS) ∧ (δ.comp θ.toLinearMap = partialB)
